slots.notes: Full-page background image behind the 3x2 card grid; background-size cover, center, no-repeat on the min-h-screen outer container.

Card 1 (top-left, dark 'Simplify Your Work With AI') accent video, anchored absolute top-0 right-0 at 75% height, object-cover, mirrored via scaleX(-1) under a from-black gradient; autoplay loop muted playsInline.
Card 2 (top-center, dark 'Your Insights. One Clear Overview.') fullscreen background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover z-0 under a from-black gradient; autoplay loop muted playsInline.
Card 3 (top-right, light 'Work Smarter. Move Faster.') background video pushed down via pt-[140px] under a white top-fade overlay, absolute inset-0 object-cover; autoplay loop muted playsInline.

Card 4 (bottom-left, dark 'Focus in a Distracted World') fullscreen background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover z-0 under a bottom-anchored from-black/70 gradient; autoplay loop muted playsInline.

Card 5 (bottom-center, light 'Beyond silence, we build the eternal.') video in a top:140px container; NOT looped — custom rAF opacity fade (0.5s in/out) with a manual replay on ended; starts opacity 0, autoplay muted playsInline, no loop.
Card 6 (bottom-right, dark 'Innovating the spirit of bloom') fullscreen background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover z-0 under a from-black/80 gradient; autoplay loop muted playsInline.

mechanic: A static min-h-screen flex-centered 3x2 grid (repeat(3,384px), 16px gap) of six 384px rounded post cards over a cover background image, each card layering an autoplaying object-cover video under a fade gradient with staggered fade-rise text — card 5 swaps the loop for a requestAnimationFrame opacity fade-in/out with manual replay.
techDelivery: Vite React + TypeScript (App.tsx + per-card CardOne..CardSix components), CDN Tailwind with extended fontFamily config, Google Fonts loaded via a single index.html link, lucide-react icons, and custom keyframes in index.css.
reskinNotes: Per-card copy, brand names (Corewave, Neuralyn, Stellar.ai, Velorah, Aethera, plus aerospace/brand-name rows), and trademark glyphs are hardcoded in each card's JSX; muted greys are inline hex (#6F6F6F, #d4d8e8) and card-3 brand row uses an inline Georgia serif rather than a token; the .liquid-glass / .liquid-glass-strong glassmorphism (rgba whites, mask-composite ::before gradient borders) and seven declared Google fonts are baked into index.css/Tailwind config, so a reskin must edit CSS and markup, not just swap tokens; card backgrounds alternate hardcoded black/white per card.
